label: Food Editorial
description: Editorial food photography: hero dish or drink, styling and appetizing light.
prefix: A cover-worthy editorial food photograph — the dish so present you can smell it, every texture begging to be touched, styled with restraint that lets the food do the talking.
suffix: Appetite Rendering: (glistening surface moisture and crumb texture resolved:1.2), steam behaving physically, honest saturated-but-real color, tactile depth that triggers hunger on sight.
negative: watermark, text, plastic-looking food, artificial gloss, grey unappetizing tones
